name: Hyrule Castle north connector

points.label: stair_west_corridor
points.notes: West of CastleRoom01 spawn on y=120; still 0x01 (0x50 door is further west ~x=522)

points.label: down_stair_approach
points.notes: B1 reverse landing. Hold UP into north-wall well → 0x72. DOWN from here walks south to y=144, no transition.

doors.label: west_to_0x50
doors.notes: Long LEFT; multi-screen y jump on landing

doors.label: east_to_0x52
doors.notes: Measured 29f RIGHT from spawn; natural chain from 0x50 east lands ~x=560 then continues east → 0x52

doors.label: down_to_0x72
doors.notes: F1-side of 0x72 north-wall stairs. Trigger is UP (not DOWN). 0x50-east leftover lands 0x01 ~(560,120), west of the well: east on y=120 to x=760, then (760,99), hold UP ~16f room-change (last F1 pixel ~(760,82)). Independent settle ~268f past submodule 14 → 0x72 ~(1273,3665) submodule 0. Natural entry from CastleRoom50 east; reverse north_to_0x01 stays isolated.

notes: Connector between 0x50 and 0x52; low hostile density at CastleRoom01.
2026-08-02: east_to_0x52 clears on the natural 0x50→0x01 predecessor chain.
2026-09-20: down_to_0x72 natural_entry from CastleRoom50 east leftover ~(560,120) → well UP → 0x72 (1273,3665). Reverse north_to_0x01 stays isolated.
